messages.author: Ville Ranta
messages.text:
Hi Pekka, at the site. Changed the SFP on transmission node TRN-233.
Link is up and alarms cleared, but traffic is still not coming back.

messages.author: Pekka Laine
messages.text: Is this one of the older units?

messages.author: Ville Ranta
messages.text: Yes, it is one of the older units.

messages.author: Pekka Laine
messages.text:
Sometimes after changing the SFP the forwarding state does not recover on those.
Disable the interface, wait a little, then enable it again.
